<p class="tagline">Three sides of every dollar.</p>

<p class="hero-lede">tfd, the Trifold engine, builds the books for small businesses that bill through Stripe. It signs a receipt for every payment, for the customer to keep, and seals every closed month. Anyone can check both with a free, open verifier. Trifold will host it.</p>

<p class="meta"><strong>{{< meta brief-audience >}}</strong> · {{< meta brief-length >}} · Draft of 7 November 2026</p>

Names (AGENTS.md, "Names"): Trifold is the company and the hosted service; tfd is the engine and CLI; Rifo is the AI agent and is not shipped.
